## GET /admin-api/audit-export

`getAuditExport`

**Where this realm's audit events are delivered (#641)**

Everything Monitoring → Audit export draws: each destination without its secrets, this process's queue and delivery counters, and the page's settings. Figures are this process. Each process delivers its own events.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/audit-export` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

## POST /admin-api/audit-export/add

`addAuditExportDestination`

**Add an audit export destination**

Creates a destination. A secret that will not seal is refused. A private address, a cloud metadata address, a URL with user information, and a filesystem path outside the allowed roots are refused. Audited, without the address or the secret.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/audit-export` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ack` | boolean |  | Splunk HEC: wait for the indexer ack before the cursor moves. One event is in flight. |
| `appName` | string |  | syslog and logrhythm: the APP-NAME. iya-sts when empty. |
| `contentType` | string |  | webhook: the content type. Empty is JSON, or text when a template is set. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Whether the job delivers to it. |
| `excludeAttributes` | string |  | More detail names to remove, separated by commas. |
| `facility` | integer |  | syslog and logrhythm. 16 is local0. |
| `headers` | string |  | webhook: plain headers, one "Name: value" a line. Sent back on a change. Empty replaces them. A name that looks like a credential is sealed instead. |
| `host` | string |  | syslog and logrhythm: the host. |
| `id` | string | yes | The destination id. A letter or a digit, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It does not change. |
| `index` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the index. Empty uses the token's. |
| `mode` | string |  | file: three octal digits, such as 640. |
| `name` | string |  | What to call it on the page. |
| `path` | string |  | file: an absolute path. |
| `port` | integer |  | syslog and logrhythm: the port. 0 or omitted is 6514 for TLS and 514 otherwise. |
| `rotateBytes` | integer |  | file: rotate at this size. 0 is off. |
| `secretHeaders` | string |  | webhook: sealed headers, one "Name: value" a line. Never returned. Empty keeps every one. A blank value keeps that one name. |
| `source` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the source. iya-sts when empty. |
| `sourcetype` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the sourcetype. iya:audit when empty. |
| `template` | string |  | webhook: one line with {timestamp} and the other placeholders. Empty sends the canonical event as JSON. |
| `token` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the collector token. Never returned. Empty on a change keeps it. |
| `transport` | one of `tcp`, `udp`, `tls` |  | syslog and logrhythm. TCP when omitted. UDP is fire-and-forget. |
| `type` | one of `syslog`, `file`, `webhook`, `splunk`, `logrhythm` | yes | syslog, file, webhook, splunk, or logrhythm. LogRhythm is the syslog adapter. |
| `url` | string |  | webhook or Splunk HEC: an https URL. |

## POST /admin-api/audit-export/enable

`enableAuditExportDestination`

**Enable an audit export destination**

The next run delivers to it. A destination that was never enabled is backfilled from the ring this process still holds. One that was disabled continues from its cursor. Audited.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/audit-export` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

## POST /admin-api/audit-export/update

`updateAuditExportDestination`

**Change an audit export destination**

The members given replace the destination's. An empty token or secret header keeps the stored one. Plain headers, including empty, replace. Checked as add is. Audited, without the address or the secret.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/audit-export` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ack` | boolean |  | Splunk HEC: wait for the indexer ack before the cursor moves. One event is in flight. |
| `appName` | string |  | syslog and logrhythm: the APP-NAME. iya-sts when empty. |
| `contentType` | string |  | webhook: the content type. Empty is JSON, or text when a template is set. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Whether the job delivers to it. |
| `excludeAttributes` | string |  | More detail names to remove, separated by commas. |
| `facility` | integer |  | syslog and logrhythm. 16 is local0. |
| `headers` | string |  | webhook: plain headers, one "Name: value" a line. Sent back on a change. Empty replaces them. A name that looks like a credential is sealed instead. |
| `host` | string |  | syslog and logrhythm: the host. |
| `id` | string | yes | The destination id. A letter or a digit, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It does not change. |
| `index` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the index. Empty uses the token's. |
| `mode` | string |  | file: three octal digits, such as 640. |
| `name` | string |  | What to call it on the page. |
| `path` | string |  | file: an absolute path. |
| `port` | integer |  | syslog and logrhythm: the port. 0 or omitted is 6514 for TLS and 514 otherwise. |
| `rotateBytes` | integer |  | file: rotate at this size. 0 is off. |
| `secretHeaders` | string |  | webhook: sealed headers, one "Name: value" a line. Never returned. Empty keeps every one. A blank value keeps that one name. |
| `source` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the source. iya-sts when empty. |
| `sourcetype` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the sourcetype. iya:audit when empty. |
| `template` | string |  | webhook: one line with {timestamp} and the other placeholders. Empty sends the canonical event as JSON. |
| `token` | string |  | Splunk HEC: the collector token. Never returned. Empty on a change keeps it. |
| `transport` | one of `tcp`, `udp`, `tls` |  | syslog and logrhythm. TCP when omitted. UDP is fire-and-forget. |
| `type` | one of `syslog`, `file`, `webhook`, `splunk`, `logrhythm` |  | syslog, file, webhook, splunk, or logrhythm. LogRhythm is the syslog adapter. |
| `url` | string |  | webhook or Splunk HEC: an https URL. |

**200**: The destination, without its secrets.

`getOutboundDeliveries`

**Every outbound delivery on the shared queue, by kind**

What /admin/deliveries draws: for each kind — backchannel-logout, ciba and provider-commands — its counts by state and its rows, newest first. `state` (pending, sent, dead), `kind` and `q` narrow. Never a token or a body.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/deliveries` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

| `q` | query | string |  | Narrows the deliveries. |
| `per` | query | integer |  | Rows per page of each kind, capped. |
| `backchannelLogoutPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of one kind's rows; each kind moves on its own parameter, its `paging.param`. |
| `cibaPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of one kind's rows; each kind moves on its own parameter, its `paging.param`. |

## GET /admin-api/passkey-report

`getPasskeyReport`

**Who holds which passkey algorithm, across the realm (#942)**

Everything Monitoring → Passkeys draws. `people`: `total`, `holding`, `postQuantumOnly`, `classicalOnly`, `both`, `none` and `withPostQuantum` — a person's kind is the ALGORITHM of their keys (ML-DSA is post-quantum), never the lane. `keys`: `total`, `postQuantum`, `classical`, `byLane` and `byAlgorithm` (each `algorithm`, `coseAlg`, `lane`, `postQuantum`, `count`). `models`: each AAGUID with its name and the algorithms its keys use. `attestation`: the leaf certificate's signature algorithm (#941). `recorded` is false when no counted passkey stored one. `profiles`: each passkey profile's `postQuantumRequired` and selectors. `counted`: where the numbers came from — the recount's `baseline` (when, how long, how many holders) plus the `changesSince` noted as keys were written, or the `population` a filter read; null before the first recount. With `list`, a page of the people behind one count, paged by `page`, `per` and `from` (the cursor `list.paging.nextFrom` hands back); a realm list reads at most 20000 entries a request and says `complete: false` when that stopped it. NO COUNT IS A SCAN OF THE DIRECTORY: the realm's are a maintained aggregate.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/passkey-report` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | query | string |  | Count the members of this group only (its cn or its DN). At most 50000 members are read; `population.complete` says whether that was all of them. |
| `profile` | query | string |  | Count the people a NAMED passkey profile selects by group (#535, #1235: the members of the groups whose `stsPasskeyPolicy` names it), bounded as `group` is. `default` is refused: it selects nobody by group. |
| `application` | query | string |  | An application's population: anybody may sign in to it, so the counts are the realm's, with `application` saying which passkey profile governs its sign-ins and how many group-selected profiles could still win for a person. |
| `list` | query | one of `post-quantum-only`, `classical-only`, `both`, `none`, `holding`, `algorithm`, `model` |  | The people behind one count: a kind (`post-quantum-only`, `classical-only`, `both`, `none`), everybody `holding` a passkey, one `algorithm` (with `algorithm` and, optionally, `lane`) or one `model` (with `aaguid`). |
| `algorithm` | query | string |  | With `list=algorithm`: the JOSE name, `ML-DSA-65`, `ES256` and the like. |
| `lane` | query | one of `classical`, `pqc` |  | With `list=algorithm`: only keys made in this lane (#643). |
| `aaguid` | query | string |  | With `list=model`: the AAGUID, or `unreported` for keys whose authenticator named none. |
| `page` | query | integer |  | Which page of `list.rows`. |
| `per` | query | integer |  | Rows per page. |
| `from` | query | string |  | Where `page` starts: the `nextFrom` the page before answered. Without it a page is found by reading from the start. |

**200**: The report.

## GET /admin-api/passkey-report/evidence

`exportPasskeyAttestationEvidence`

**Download one passkey RFC 4998 evidence record (#947)**

Returns the exact archived attestation object and its RFC 4998 EvidenceRecord for one passkey. The TSA token is independently verifiable against the configured TSA trust anchors. A key has no evidence when no TSA was configured when it was enrolled, or when its attestation was not trusted and classical.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/users` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | query | string | yes |  |
| `credentialId` | query | string | yes |  |

**200**: The RFC 4998 EvidenceRecord and archived data.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credentialId` | string |  |  |
| `evidence` | any JSON |  | The attestation statement an authenticator sent, archived as it was: its members are WebAuthn's per attestation format. The attestation statement an authenticator sent, archived as it was: its members are WebAuthn's per attestation format. |
| `username` | string |  |  |

**400**: The answer.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string |  |  |
| `error_description` | string |  |  |
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean |  |  |

## GET /admin-api/passkey-report/export

`exportPasskeyReport`

**Every person behind one passkey count, as CSV or JSON**

The people `list` names (every passkey holder when it is absent), in the filter the report takes, as a file: CSV (`username`, `dn`, `kind`, `passkeys`, `algorithms`, `lanes`, `aaguids`, `models`; a cell a spreadsheet would read as a formula is prefixed with an apostrophe) or JSON (`rows`, each with its `keys`). At most 100000 rows; the JSON says `truncated`, and so does the header `X-Passkey-Report-Truncated`. Read asynchronously, holders only, as the lists are. No secret is in it: a public key is not exported.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/passkey-report` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | query | string |  | Count the members of this group only (its cn or its DN). At most 50000 members are read; `population.complete` says whether that was all of them. |
| `profile` | query | string |  | Count the people a NAMED passkey profile selects by group (#535, #1235: the members of the groups whose `stsPasskeyPolicy` names it), bounded as `group` is. `default` is refused: it selects nobody by group. |
| `application` | query | string |  | An application's population: anybody may sign in to it, so the counts are the realm's, with `application` saying which passkey profile governs its sign-ins and how many group-selected profiles could still win for a person. |
| `list` | query | one of `post-quantum-only`, `classical-only`, `both`, `none`, `holding`, `algorithm`, `model` |  | The people behind one count: a kind (`post-quantum-only`, `classical-only`, `both`, `none`), everybody `holding` a passkey, one `algorithm` (with `algorithm` and, optionally, `lane`) or one `model` (with `aaguid`). |
| `algorithm` | query | string |  | With `list=algorithm`: the JOSE name, `ML-DSA-65`, `ES256` and the like. |
| `lane` | query | one of `classical`, `pqc` |  | With `list=algorithm`: only keys made in this lane (#643). |
| `aaguid` | query | string |  | With `list=model`: the AAGUID, or `unreported` for keys whose authenticator named none. |
| `format` | query | one of `csv`, `json` |  | `csv` (the default) or `json`. |

**200**: The file, as an attachment.

## POST /admin-api/passkey-report/recount

`recountPasskeyReport`

**Count the realm's passkeys again, now**

Queues a run of the `passkeys.report-recount` job for this realm on the scheduler's leader (#49), which reads every passkey holder a page at a time and makes the result the new baseline — putting right whatever the changes noted since could not see (a bulk import, a restore). It runs where every job runs, never on this request: the answer is the queued run (`runId`, `alreadyQueued`), and Monitoring → Scheduler shows it. Audited by the scheduler.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/passkey-report` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body** (optional)

An empty object.

**200**: The queued run.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string |  |  |
| `alreadyQueued` | boolean |  |  |
| `error` | string |  |  |
| `error_description` | string |  |  |
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `runId` | string |  |  |
